name: GVP
tagline: SE(3)-equivariant geometric vector perceptron encoder over backbone-derived scalar/vector features.

nodes.label: Node (6 scalar / 3 vector) + Edge (16+16 RBF / 1 vector)

pseudocode:
1. Build kNN graph on Cα; node scalars = 6 dihedrals, node vectors = unit (Cα→N, Cα→C, Cα→O).
2. Edge scalars = 16 RBF distances + 16-d sinusoidal residue offset; edge vector = unit Cα→Cα'.
3. GVP input projects (s,v) tuples; GVPLayerNorm normalises scalar + rescales vector magnitude.
4. For each layer: gather neighbour (s,v); message GVP -> mean over masked neighbours; feed-forward GVP; residual + norm.
5. Project final scalar features to hidden_dim and feed an MLP decoder for amino-acid logits.
diff_from_baseline: Jing et al., ICLR 2021 — Geometric Vector Perceptrons. SE(3)-equivariant message passing over scalar+vector tuples, the canonical structure-aware baseline for protein representation learning.

name: PiFold
tagline: Rich multi-atom-pair geometric features with virtual atoms and attention-based message passing for non-autoregressive inverse folding.

nodes.label: Node: 6 atom-pair RBFs + 3 virtual-pair RBFs + 6 dihedrals + 6 orient
Edge: 15 atom-pair RBFs + 9 virtual RBFs + 4 angles + 8 dirs + 16 PE
x10 PiFold layer (attn + FFN + edge MLP + ctx gate)

pseudocode:
1. Build kNN graph on Cα; learn 3 virtual atoms in the local N-Cα-C frame.
2. Node features: RBFs over 6 intra-residue atom pairs + virtual pairs, plus 6 dihedrals and 6 frame orientations.
3. Edge features: RBFs over 15 inter-residue atom pairs + virtual pairs, 4 angles, 8 directions, 16-d positional encoding.
4. PiFoldLayer = multi-head attention with edge-conditioned bias + FFN + edge-update MLP + global mean-pool context gate.
5. After 10 layers, single Linear decoder predicts amino-acid logits non-autoregressively.
diff_from_baseline: Gao et al., ICLR 2023 — PiFold. Combines virtual atoms, multi-atom-pair RBFs and an attention-based encoder with global context gating; current SOTA-class baseline for non-autoregressive fixed-backbone design.

name: ProteinMPNN
tagline: MPNN encoder with all 25 backbone+Cβ pairwise RBF edge features plus positional encoding.

nodes.label: N, Cα, C, O + virtual Cβ
Edge: 25 atom-pair RBFs + 16 PE; Node: fwd+sidechain orient (6)
x3 EncLayer (node + edge update via concat-MLP)

pseudocode:
1. Build virtual Cβ from N-Cα-C, then kNN graph on Cα distances.
2. Compute 25 pairwise RBFs over all (N,Cα,C,O,Cβ) atom pairs and concatenate with sinusoidal residue-offset encoding to form edge features.
3. Node features = forward Cα direction and sidechain orientation vector.
4. EncLayer: concat $[h_i, e_{ij}, h_j]$ -> 3-layer MLP message; sum-aggregate / scale=30 + LayerNorm + residual; then symmetric edge-update MLP and LayerNorm.
5. Decoder MLP maps final node features to amino-acid log-probs (simplified non-autoregressive head).
diff_from_baseline: Dauparas et al., Science 2022 — ProteinMPNN. All-atom pairwise distance MPNN that became the de-facto reference for backbone-conditioned protein design.
